what_happened: Both siting-branch questions (predecessor jq-record disposition, sibling lean anchor-record disposition) resolved by direct file reads with no ambiguity; no web research needed, no helper-script question reopened.

No deviation from the dispatch; both siting branches re-confirmed against live files.

Initial draft of bounded-block-edit.md pre-filled the anchor-transplant subsection with a paraphrase of the lean section-anchoring rule instead of leaving a placeholder for Phase 3's verbatim sed-extract-and-diff transplant; caught before committing and corrected to a placeholder comment.

Phase 3's Scope Hypothesis re-grep for 'Section-anchoring rule' (outside specs/**) returned TWO files, not the one the plan's authoring-time research claimed: agent-system/extensions/lean/context/project/lean4/agents/lean-implementation-flow.md (the full 9-line paragraph, lines 120-128, the transplant source) AND agent-system/extensions/lean/agents/lean-implementation-agent.md (a pre-existing 5-line condensed paragraph added by a prior, unrelated task, already phrased as a pointer: 'See ...lean-implementation-flow.md's Stage 4A for the full rationale and failure example'). The second copy predates this task's planning dispatch, so the research's claim of a single match appears to have missed it rather than reflecting new drift. lean-implementation-agent.md is not in this task's declared file_scope, so it is left unedited; after Phase 3 reduces the flow file's own paragraph to a pointer at the new core file, lean-implementation-agent.md's phrase 'for the full rationale and failure example' will resolve through one extra hop (flow.md's pointer, then the core file) rather than landing on the full rationale directly. Proceeding with the transplant as planned since the second copy is already pointer-shaped and not a competing full restatement; flagged as a candidate minor follow-up to update lean-implementation-agent.md's wording in a future task with that file in scope.

Phase 5's first deploy-headless.sh run landed but reported RESULT=landed_verify_red: Gate 20 (orchestrator context budget lock) failed because the new claudemd.md 'Bounded Block Edits' pointer section (added in Phase 2) pushed the predicted assembled CLAUDE.md's eager-load total to 70566 B, 166 B over the recorded 70400 B baseline in orchestrator-context-budget.json. Not anticipated by the plan, which only tracked index-entries.json line_count drift. Resolved by trimming the pointer section's wording (two sentences instead of two paragraphs, same trigger-plus-mechanism content, same single Full-documentation pointer) to 350 B from its original 553 B, landing the measured eager-load total at 70363 B, 37 B under baseline with no baseline move needed -- following this budget file's own established 'always trim before moving the ceiling' precedent. Re-deploy then reported RESULT=landed_verify_clean, 41/41 checks passing.
